name: Current PC, Camoufox, pinned device per account
description: Keep today's setup: all accounts on one Windows PC, one pinned spoofed device each, accept that GPU/canvas pixels are shared.

name: Current PC + 2Captcha Fingerprint API values injected
description: Same PC and Camoufox, but pull each account's device values (UA, WebGL vendor/renderer/params, screen, fonts, voices, canvas hash) from 2Captcha's Fingerprint API and pin them in Twenty instead of BrowserForge.

name: 2Captcha Browser API (remote cloud browser)
description: Drive 2Captcha's hosted headful Chromium/Firefox over CDP with its claimed kernel-level fingerprint spoofing, persistent profiles and its residential proxies.

name: boat.dev Linux VM per account running Camoufox
description: One persistent boat.dev Ubuntu VM (EU, no GPU, software rendering) per account, running log-cli + Camoufox inside, exiting through the account's 2Captcha proxy, snapshot/stop between runs.

name: Managed cloud browser vendor (Browserbase, Kernel, Steel, Hyperbrowser, Anchor)
description: A hosted stealth browser per account from a browser-infrastructure vendor, with persistent contexts and bring-your-own proxy.

name: GPU sandbox or GPU cloud browser (Daytona GPU passthrough, Kernel GPU browsers, Modal)
description: A managed sandbox or hosted headful browser with a real datacenter GPU in the rendering path, one per account, running Camoufox or the vendor browser through the account's proxy.

name: Cloud Windows VM with a GPU per account
description: One Windows VM with a real or virtual GPU (e.g. AWS g4dn/g5, Azure NV, Paperspace, Shadow PC) per account or small group, running log-cli + Camoufox.

name: Commercial anti-detect browser (Multilogin, GoLogin, AdsPower, Octo, Kameleo)
description: Replace Camoufox with a commercial anti-detect browser profile per account, using its canvas/WebGL noise or real-device fingerprint database, on the current PC.

name: Cloud phone / Android emulator per account (GeeLark, DuoPlus, VMOS)
description: Run each account in the Facebook mobile app on a cloud Android phone, automated through the vendor's API, with the account's proxy.

name: Cheap real physical device per account
description: One used Android phone or mini PC per account (or per 2-3 accounts), running the account through the account's proxy, controlled remotely from Vietnam.

name: Software-only: per-account canvas/WebGL noise + split iGPU/dGPU on the current PC
description: Stay on the PC; add seeded per-account canvas and WebGL readback noise, and alternate accounts between the AMD iGPU and NVIDIA dGPU, to break the single shared hash.
